2026-10-10.title: Solo difficulty, new solo rules and the XP table
new: Solo has three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium and Hard, with 25, 20 or 15 rounds, and Fated on 1-2, 1-4 or 1-6. In a game in progress, + rolls the Phantom's die and shows whether you're Fated, and + after your last round ends the game, lost. Under Solo, filter by difficulty.
improved: Under the players' Leaderboard, XP table shows what a game is worth: by how many players claimed their villain, lost or won.
Solo has new rules in the FAQ: you play against a Phantom player, and eight villains get a fix of their own.
fixed: A game timed in New Game without the round counter is no longer recorded with 1 round.

2026-10-09.title: Solo, XP, and fixing a recorded game
new: Solo, an unofficial variant for one player: your villain against the game, with 20 turns to reach the Objective. Record it from New Game; solo games have their own rankings and stats, under the dashed Solo pill, and never count with the others. The FAQ summarizes its rules.

The players' Leaderboard opens on XP: for every game where you claimed your villain, 1 for each player who claimed theirs, you included, and if you won, 1 more for each of the others; plus 1 for each achievement.
Whoever recorded a game can change its villains and its winner until another player claims a villain, and can delete the game from its page.
Villain Movers: next to each villain's name, and in a row while a game is in progress.
Seven new avatar images.
Join the beta from your account page to try new features before everyone else.
improved: After saving a game, its page opens with the QR code on top: close it to check the villains, the winner and the details.
On a villain's page, tap a table size, or Solo, to see its numbers in the boxes on top.
Achievements are now only on player pages: the ones earned, and with Show all also those still to earn.
The villains' Leaderboard always lists every villain, even those without games in the chosen filters.

2026-10-07.title: Leaderboard and Game Log by year and month
new: All time, Year and Month in the Leaderboard, the Game Log and player pages: pick a year, then a month to narrow it down. On a player page, achievements and Most played with stay all-time.
The monthly report moved from the Villains page into the Leaderboard, with the full ranking instead of the top and bottom three, for players too and for each table size.
This page: what's new on DiVilytics, update by update.
improved: % Wins no longer hides entries with fewer than 5 games: they're listed after the ranking, without a position.
What's new tints in purple what changed since your last visit.

2026-10-06.title: Every villain guide, more games, keyboard shortcuts
new: A guide for every villain, Introduction to Evil included: the objective and how each villain plays.
Game logs shared on the Disney Villainous Subreddit. Imported games without a date say Date unknown and come last in the Game Log.
Keyboard shortcuts on a computer: a key for each page and setting, / for the search box. Press ? for the list.
improved: The round counter shows the current round, starting from 1, and − can't go below it (on the lock screen too).
Villain filters: Reset goes back to where you started (your boxes, in New Game).
Villainous Italia games show only their date, since the sheet has no time.
fixed: A game started by mistake and paused within the first minute no longer saves a duration and one round.

2026-10-05.title: A smoother New Game, text size and Install
new: Text size in Settings: Small or Large.
Install on the home page adds DiVilytics to your home screen (or shows the steps, on iPhone and Mac).
Game Log: With these finds the games that had every villain you pick at the table.
improved: New Game keeps one game at a time: a game in progress is there when you come back, ready to resume.
The form and the draw pool are kept while you edit, and the draw pool starts from your boxes.
One draw button that fills the empty rows or redraws them all, disabled when the draw pool is too small.
If the lock-screen controls need a tap after you come back, a full-screen "Tap to continue" asks for it.
Every pop-up closes by dragging it down, or with Esc on a computer.
Back links return to the page you came from.
New Game gets its own ⚔️ icon.

2026-10-04.title: DiVilytics in Italian, villain guides and Settings
new: DiVilytics in Italian, with the F.A.Q., card names, card texts, objectives and guides as printed in the Italian edition.
Villain guides: the objective and how the villain plays, with links to its cards.
Settings (⚙️ in the top bar): theme and language.
F.A.Q.: the official rules summarized, and what Introduction to Evil changes.
improved: New Game has simpler lineup controls: one draw button and Random order.

2026-10-03.title: Tutorial, F.A.Q. and villain decks
new: Tutorial: from your first game to finding your stats.
F.A.Q.: the rules clarifications of the Villainous Italia F.A.Q., general and villain by villain, with a search box.
Villain pages show the Villain and Fate decks card by card; tap a card for its text.
Rivalries add Faced most, next to Beaten most and Lost to most.
improved: Characters are now called Villains.
Game cards list the players in play order, with their seat numbers.
Games over time shows the last 12 months; drag to see earlier ones.
A player's Max streak turns gold while they're on their best streak.
Rivalries count only opponents faced in at least 5 games.
Box names show their release year.

2026-08-06.title: Introduction to Evil and Darkness Brewing
new: Introduction to Evil: its four reworked villains are villains of their own ([I2E]), with their own stats.
Darkness Brewing: its reprinted villains are listed under it too, and you can mark it among your boxes.
Download all your games as a CSV from your Account.
improved: The % Wins ranking only includes entries with at least 5 games, so one lucky win can't top it.
fixed: My boxes now works villain by villain for reprinted villains: one still counts if you own any of its boxes.

2026-07-21.title: Three new villains
new: Ernesto de la Cruz and Prince Hans (Success at Any Cost), and the Sanderson Sisters (Come, We Fly!).
improved: The Leaderboard shows 30 rows at a time, with Load more.

2026-06-24.title: Charts and the Players page
new: Charts: games over time and by weekday, players per game, game length and rounds, win rate by pace, by box and against popularity, box popularity, play-order advantage and more.
Players: search for any player and open their profile, or share yours with a QR code.
Villains: group them by box or by pace.

2026-06-18.title: Rivalries and friends
new: Villain pages show each villain's rivalries: the villains it beats most and loses to most.
Player pages show who they play with most.

2026-06-16.title: New Account page, villain filters and more achievements
new: A new Account page: change your nickname, pick your avatar, share your profile.
New Game's Draw pool: leave villains out of the random draw, or limit it to your boxes.
Game Log: filter the games by villain.
Villains: a monthly report with the top and bottom villains of the month.
The Leaderboard shows your position at the bottom when you're further down.
New achievements: games played, locations, every table size and every seat, every pace, players played with and beaten, longest win streak.
Acknowledgments on the home page.
improved: The Game Log loads more games as you go, with Load more.

2026-06-07.title: Build your own avatar
new: Build your own avatar: body, face, eyes, hair and more over a background color, or pick one of the images.
Places you've already used are suggested when you type a location, in New Game and when editing a game.

2026-06-01.title: A new way to claim your villain
new: Scanning a game's QR code opens its claim page: claim the villain you played, or release it if you picked the wrong one.
Players of a game can edit its location, duration and rounds, and show its QR code again.

2026-05-17.title: Sign in with Google
new: Sign in with Google as well as Discord, from a new sign-in page.
Link both to the same profile from your Account (you need to keep at least one).

2026-05-14.title: My boxes and achievements
new: Mark the boxes you own on your Account; New Game can limit the random draw to their villains.
Achievements: bronze, silver and gold for every villain, for games played and won (1, 5 and 10), on your Account and on player pages.
Choose your player icon.
Shuffle order randomizes the play order.
improved: The counter says rounds instead of turns: a round ends when every player has had their turn.

2026-05-10.title: New Game and Game Log
new: Recording a game has its own page, New Game, and the game history becomes the Game Log.
The random draw moved into New Game: draw every villain or only the empty rows, and draw by pace (Pace+ adds the neighboring colors).
A game in progress can be resumed or discarded.

2026-05-07.title: A new name and the rules clarifications
new: The site is now called DiVilytics (it started as DVS, Disney Villainous Stats).
Each villain's page shows the rules clarifications (F.A.Q.) for that villain.
improved: Filtered game history pages through every result.

2026-04-23.title: DVS goes online
new: Record your games: pick the villains or draw them at random, randomize the play order, and time the game with a counter that keeps working with the screen locked.
Save the game and share its QR code, so the other players can link their profiles to the villains they played.
Game history, a leaderboard of villains and players, and a page for every villain and every player with win rates and stats.
Sign in with Discord and choose a unique nickname.
Dark, light or automatic theme.
